name: Palmier Pro
description: Exposes a macOS video editor timeline over MCP so agents can cut, arrange and render video programmatically from Claude, Cursor or Codex.

skills.name: Timeline Editing
skills.description: Adds, trims and reorders clips on the editor timeline through MCP calls so an agent can assemble a cut end to end.

skills.name: Media Import
skills.description: Imports local footage, audio and images into the project and reports duration and metadata back to the agent.

skills.name: Export And Render
skills.description: Renders the current timeline to a video file at a chosen resolution and codec, returning the output path.
